title: Public exact vector resources
objective: Route public dense vectors over ZZ and QQ through generated FmpzVector and FmpqVector resources while preserving Sage semantics and eliminating list materialization from same-base arithmetic and exact matrix-vector result publication
references: ffi/flint.ffi.py generated FmpzVector and FmpqVector ABI at base commit 994c32b

oracles: SageMath dense vector semantics over ZZ and QQ

handoff.summary: Public dense vectors over ZZ and QQ canonically own generated FmpzVector/FmpqVector resources. Construction, mutation, same-base arithmetic, scalar products, and equality stay on the resource; exact matrix-vector results are adopted without materializing a host element list. SageMath and native-disabled differential tests cover the public contract, and a 100000-entry benchmark records warmed resource arithmetic.
risks: The current exact matrix-vector ABI exchanges a canonical ByteRegion: input serializes and reparses the vector, while output serializes a temporary FLINT result and parses/copies it into the public resource. No host element list is constructed, but this is not zero-copy.

Exact slicing bulk-materializes and re-imports once, and mixed ZZ/QQ arithmetic currently materializes during FmpzVector-to-FmpqVector conversion; neither path has a direct generated resource declaration yet.
This lane deliberately overlaps src/baselib/matrix.py with its declared qq-sparse-random dependency and must be integrated after that lane.
next_steps: Add direct FmpzVector/FmpqVector matrix-vector declarations to remove the remaining canonical-byte copy.
Add generated exact-vector slicing and FmpzVector-to-FmpqVector conversion declarations to remove the remaining host-list boundaries.
Register exact_vector_public.py in pyrightconfig.json through the shared integration lane.
Extend resource-backed bulk publication to exact matrix rows, columns, and diagonals when profiling justifies it.
